applies_to: United CoolAir packaged and vertical self-contained air conditioning units with the Marvel Premium controller and the BMS communications option (VAV and DOAS options included).
summary: The Marvel Premium controller on United CoolAir units exposes its BMS points as Analog, Binary, Positive Integer, Integer and Multistate Values: temperatures, humidities, pressures and demands, return/space/supply setpoints for cooling, heating and humidity control, damper limits, fan motor data, compressor and system status, schedules (start/end hour and minute per day), BMS mode selection, on/off, unoccupied override and alarm flags with a BMS alarm reset.
notes: Instances here are the form's Index column, which restarts at 1 for each object type. The form never says the Index is the BACnet object instance and the IOM does not cover BACnet object numbering, so treat the instances as unconfirmed and check them with a device scan before mapping.
Gaps in the index (e.g. AV 45-49) are not printed; rows marked Reserved (AV 85, 97-99, 161-170, BV 140, IV 1) are left out.
Units are not printed; temperatures default in °F (e.g. ReturnCool_Setpoint default 73.00).
PIV 55 is printed SAT_StartMin although its description is Saturday Occupied End Hour; kept as printed.
Fan-motor objects marked (Ziehl-Abegg Fans Only) apply only to units with those fans.
The IOM lists BACnet among the BMS options on the J25 RS-485 port but the points form does not state the transport.

source.title: BACNET Form MARVPREM_BMS_07_14_2023 (Marvel Premium BMS points list)

integration.summary: Start and stop the unit with BV 1 SystemOnOff or drive modes with MV 1 BMS_ModeSelection, write the setpoint for the control type in use (return, space or supply), and read temperatures, MV 7 SystemStatus, blower status and alarms. BV 141 resets active alarms.

minimum_points.name: BMS_ModeSelection
minimum_points.why: BMS mode: occupied, unoccupied, setback, off...

integration.enable: BV 1 SystemOnOff (R/W) switches the unit; MV 1 BMS_ModeSelection (R/W) selects 1 disabled, 2 unit off, 3 morning warm-up, 4 cool-down, 5 setback, 6 unoccupied, 7 occupied, 8 emergency stop. Per the IOM, BMS-based unoccupied override, morning warm-up and cool-down need the BMS communications option.
setup: The IOM shows BMS communications on the J25 RS-485 port (BACnet or Modbus) and pCOWeb as options.
gotchas: Schedule PIVs (start/end hour and minute per day) are configuration; avoid cyclic writes.
Alarm flags are BVs with Normal/Alarm texts; check each alarm the unit options use.
